caption:
Everyone gave up on you after you failed. But what if one person's faith in you could rewrite the rest of your story? (Galatians 2:1 devotional)

One failure became your whole name, so you marked yourself finished and assumed everyone else had too. But God builds people by trusting them before they're safe — Barnabas vouched for the feared Saul and re-trusted failed Mark, and Mark became “useful” again. You aren't written off; His trust is rebuilding the very story you called over.

📌 Save this if you were ever given a second chance
📩 Send it to the Barnabas who once vouched for you
